questions.stem_text: An ARMA(p,q) (p, q are integers bigger than zero) model will have

options.A: An acf that declines geometrically and a pacf that is zero after p lags
options.B: An acf that declines geometrically and a pacf that is zero after p+q lags
options.C: An acf and pacf that are both zero after q lags
options.D: An acf and pacf that are both zero after p lags
options.E: An acf that is zero after q lags and a pacf that is zero after p lags

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - An acf that declines geometrically and a pacf that is zero after p lags

questions.stem_text:
Why is the Wagner Act (officially the National Labor Relations Act), considered to be
"labor's Magna Charta"?

options.A: It introduced mandatory profit sharing between employers and employees
options.B: It obligated employers to bargain in good faith with a union
options.D: It created a universal pension system for all workers regardless of employer contributions
options.E: It allowed for automatic union membership for all employees in a workplace

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It introduced mandatory profit sharing between employers and employees

questions.stem_text:
Which one of the following statements best describes the algebraic representation of the
fitted regression line?

options.A: can be used by banks to make loans or buy investments.
options.B: must be held at the FED exclusively.
options.C: must be kept in a bank's vault.
options.D: are optional for large banks but compulsory for smaller ones.
options.E: can be invested in government securities.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - can be used by banks to make loans or buy investments.

questions.stem_text:
The market for Cincinnati Reds baseball tickets is currently in equilibrium. Which of the
following events would most likely increase the consumer surplus received by Reds fans?

options.A: The Reds decrease ticket prices due to lower stadium maintenance costs.
options.B: The Reds launch a new marketing campaign that increases ticket demand.
options.C: The Reds decide to limit the number of games in a season.
options.D: The Reds offer discounted parking for all home games.
options.E: The Reds increase ticket prices due to a rise in player salaries.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The Reds offer discounted parking for all home games.
